thread:
Anika (SRE): Heads-up 1 INC-2025-0423 post-incident review needs to be scheduled. Short incident recap: inference fleet saw elevated tail latency and ~37m of elevated 500s with automatic fallback routing. Want the PIR within 72h so we can lock mitigations before the next deploy. Need a facilitator + note-taker. Pre-read will include timeline, logs, and mitigation notes.

incident-bot: incident recorded  INC-2025-0423  severity S2  timeline: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2025-0423/timeline

Liam (Eng PM): I can run this. Two windows that work for me: Tue 2025-07-01 14:00 UTC or Thu 2025-07-03 18:30 UTC. 60m preferred. Happy to co-facilitate with an SRE if needed.

Jules (Product Ops): Ill take notes and assemble the pre-read. 60 minutes works. Ill include a customer-impact summary and a short "what to read" checklist.

Ravi (Infra): Morning PT slots better for me but I can make Tue 14:00 UTC. If Liam facilitates Ill prepare the infra mitigation writeup (rollback notes, config changes we made). Will add concrete candidate actions.

Anika (SRE): @support-leads could you confirm whether Customer A CS lead should present? Well want direct customer impact statements if possible. Also we need someone to push actions into the incident board after the meeting.

oper-bot: availability poll created  https://doodle.redwood/INC-2025-0423  poll id: 79012

Nisha (Support): I can present customer timeline and ticket summary. Invited Aisha (Customer A CS) and Tom (Customer B). Ill attach ticket IDs and screenshots to the pre-read.

Liam (Eng PM): Draft agenda suggestion: 1) Quick impact + customer notes (5m) 2) Timeline & detection/mitigation walkthrough (20m) 3) Evidence & RCA hypotheses (20m) 4) Action owners and due dates (10m) 5) Validation plan and next steps (5m). Thoughts?

Anika (SRE): That looks good. Use this action line format in notes so we can import to the board: 

```
ACTION: [owner] | [priority P0/P1/P2] | [due YYYY-MM-DD] | [short description] | [verification link]
```

Jules (Product Ops): Will produce the pre-read by Mon EOD and post it here. Ill embed logs, perf graphs, and a one-slide TL;DR. Please drop any screenshots into the doc before Monday.

Ravi (Infra): Adding a sample infra action to the draft: 
```
ACTION: Ravi | P1 | 2025-07-10 | tighten memory soft-limits and tune batch-sizes on the inference pool | validation: canary run + latency histogram
```

Anika (SRE): Ive uploaded log excerpts and agent traces: https://s3.redwood/INC-2025-0423/logs_trimmed.zip. Also added the KV cache snapshot and the emergency rollback steps to the runbook.

oper-bot: calendar event created  "Post-Incident Review: INC-2025-0423"  Tue 2025-07-01 14:00 UTC  duration 60m  attendees: Anika, Liam, Jules, Ravi, Nisha  invites sent to Aisha, Tom

Nisha (Support): Aisha tentatively accepted, Tom confirmed. Ill be presenting the support tickets and impact matrix.

Liam (Eng PM): Quick ask  react with :x: if you cannot make the Tue slot and propose alternative on the doodle. If more than two core tech leads are out we will reschedule.

Anika (SRE): Confirming core participants: Anika, Liam, Jules, Ravi, Nisha; optional: Aisha, Tom for customer statements. If anyone else needs to be pulled in (runtime, model-onboarding), add them now.

Jules (Product Ops): Pre-read link: https://docs.redwood/pm/INC-2025-0423/pre-read  includes timeline, initial hypotheses, logs excerpt, and mitigations. Please review before the meeting.

Ravi (Infra): Ive pre-filled the infra mitigation candidates section in the pre-read. Example action above is in the doc.

Liam (Eng PM): After the meeting Ill publish the postmortem page and create the incident board tickets. Ill also schedule a 2-week check-in to validate remediation progress.

Anika (SRE): Great  summarizing: Facilitator: Liam; Notes & pre-read owner: Jules; Core tech leads: Anika + Ravi; Customer context: Nisha (+Aisha/Tom). Meeting Tue 14:00 UTC. React with :thumbsup: if youre good.

oper-bot: reminder set  30m before meeting  Tue 2025-07-01 13:30 UTC

Jules (Product Ops): If anyone has short validation scripts or graphs to include in the postmortem, drop them into the pre-read. Ill convert the PIR doc into the public postmortem after actions are verified closed.

Nisha (Support): Adding ticket IDs now and will upload CS correspondence. Ill also prepare a 3-slide customer impact appendix for the meeting.

Anika (SRE): If something changes, update the doodle and ping @Liam. Otherwise well run the review and ensure all ACTION lines are assigned before closing. Thanks everyone.

Liam (Eng PM): Thanks  see you Tuesday. Will capture owners and due dates during the meeting and push to the incident board afterwards. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)
